{"reason":"Replace the medium/high fallback's supplier action with alert-planner: it always arrives and costs 35,000 versus 45,000. This converts all 34 supplier switches, saving 340,000, and fixes costly stockout rows (medium inventory 5.3 and 2.8) without increasing stockouts.","source":"(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high))
          (< inventory-days 5))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else
      (list 'monitor))))"}
